display_name: Monthly Day-20 Calendar Long (Open Day 20 -> After Close Day 21)

logic.summary: Monthly calendar rule: buy at D1 open on calendar day 20 of each month and exit on the first trading D1 bar after calendar day 21 closes (day >= 22 or next month).
logic.economic_rationale: Hypothesis: recurring monthly institutional rebalancing, payroll/settlement, or options-expiry flows around the 20th-21st window create positive directional drift (requires statistical verification against multiple-testing calendar bias).
known_assumptions: If calendar day 20 falls on a weekend/holiday with no D1 bar, that month is skipped.
Causal exit executes at the open of the first trading D1 bar after day 21 ends (day >= 22); if day 20 or 21 is Friday, position holds across the weekend to Monday open.
Includes 15-second retry throttling during midnight rollover windows.
rejection_criteria: Mean return on day 20-21 fails to beat unconditional random 2-day holding windows (permutation / Bonferroni calendar test across 28 days).
Positive return vanishes after rollover spread and overnight swap costs.
